name: gap-no-turn
why: Two words in the silence between turns, on either side of the 500 ms nearestGapMs threshold. w0 is 200 ms past A's turn and is attached by proximity with margin 0 — a guess, marked as one. w1 is 1000 ms from A and 600 ms from B, beyond reach of both, and gets a NULL speaker rather than the closer of two bad answers. Never silently attribute.
